title: The Risk Quadrangle in Optimization: An Overview with Recent Results and Extensions
summary: This paper revisits and extends the 2013 development by Rockafellar and Uryasev of the Risk Quadrangle (RQ) as a unified scheme for integrating risk management, optimization, and statistical estimation. The RQ features four stochastics-oriented functionals -- risk, deviation, regret, and error, along with an associated statistic, and articulates their revealing and in some ways surprising interrelationships and dualizations. Additions to the RQ framework that have come to light since 2013 are reviewed in a synthesis focused on both theoretical advancements and practical applications. New…
